findings: Blocking: observer exceptions can alter ordinary outbox behavior. The settled observation runs before persistence inside the mutation try/catch; an append failure enters the refusal branch and removes the item. A pending observation failure also prevents the subsequent flush. Native journal operations throw, and observe does not isolate those exceptions. See src/outbox.ts:13, src/outbox.ts:15, vendor/helper/index.ts:9 and vendor/helper/ios/ObservationJournal.swift:39.

Blocking: search observations do not always describe rendered results. Offline with an empty query, prefixMatch accepts cached messages and the effect emits their IDs, while SearchBar receives an empty results array. See src/Search.tsx:6, src/Search.tsx:7, src/Search.tsx:9 and src/cache.ts:7.

The oracle creates a fresh ordinary Bob session, queries the recorded origin, exhausts the exclusive sequence cursor, preserves every returned occurrence and emits authoritative sequence/ID tuples without acknowledgements, admin reads or outcome computation.

The backend argv exactly matches the mandated operator-owned launcher. Seed uses the private instance secret only for deployment to the supplied origin; the inspected Convex existing-deployment branch does not start another backend. Legacy backend scripts are not reachable from the handoff argv.

Prepared autolinking and Expo configuration inputs reference this custody directory. The app target compiles its local AppDelegate and generated provider and bundles the custody JavaScript entry. The build wrapper uses Release, iphonesimulator, the permitted generic simulator destination and the operator-supplied DerivedData path, with build as its action.

Native and web client origins resolve to the fixed CLIQUE_NATIVE_ORIGIN through the preparation/build export and Expo production environment replacement. Seed and oracle use the operator-provided stdin origin. Required dependency versions match package.json and package-lock.json.
Message containers expose opaque IDs and preserve separate body/receipt descendants in source. This audit establishes no runtime accessibility-tree, behavioral or pixel proof.
